Commentary.Commentary: 124 to chase then. Not a very big total and South Africa do have a very good batting unit. But then, English bowlers are superb too. I think we are in for an exciting contest. Join us in a while for the run chase.

Shabnim Ismail is down for a quick chat. She says that she is happy with her performance and is happy they restricted England to a low score. Adds that herself and Marizane Kapp bowled really well. Mentions that the pitch was on the slower side and there were no demons on it. Ismail further says that 124 is chaseable and they are confident of chasing it down.

The bowling from South Africa was excellent. They used 5 bowlers and they all were superb. Apart from Mlaba who went wicketless, all the bowlers took at least a wicket. It was Ayabonga Khaka who ended with a 3-fer while Kapp, Van Niekerk ended up with 2 to their name. Shabnim Ismail took 1 wicket in her 4 overs but she was excellent in the field, taking two catches.

After being put in, Amy Jones started really well, hitting a few boundaries early on. However, once she fell, England kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Natalie Sciver though kept her end intact and with a superb half ton made sure England have something to defend. They lost the track in the middle overs and could not score freely. 48 runs in the final 5 overs meant that they crossed 120.

An excellent bowling performance from South Africa after opting to bowl. The way Amy Jones started the innings, it looked we are in for a run fest. But South African bowlers kept things tight throughout the innings after breaking the opening stand to keep England to 123.

Two runs to end the innings! It should have been a single only though. Good length ball on off, Shrubsole plays it uppishly towards the long on region and takes off for a couple. The fielder throws it to the wrong end as Shrubsole was halfway. Kapp collects the ball and then gives it to the keeper but by that time, Anya had made her way in. ENGLAND FINISH ON 123/8.
A very full delivery outside off, Ecclestone pushes it to cover for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Shrubsole looks to cut but gets an inside edge and goes towards third man. A single taken.
Anya Shrubsole is in now. 3 more balls left.

OUT! LBW! It is all reds on Ball Tracker and Tammy Beaumont has to go. They had no option but to go for the review. Fullish delivery on middle, Beaumont looks to heave it away but misses to get hit on the pads. The South African players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Beaumont goes for the review. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it was pitching in line and hitting the stumps.
A decision for LBW taken upstairs. Beaumont has been given out. It looks out. Let's see what happens.
BOUNCER! It is bowled outside off, Beaumont dances down the track and looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Slower length ball on middle, Beaumont waits for it and then half-pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Marizanne Kapp to bowl the last over of the innings.
Sophie Ecclestone is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder! South Africa keep chipping away at the wickets. Full delivery outside off, Winfield looks to scoop and times it well. Tryon does not have to move as the ball goes straight into her hands.
Fullish on middle, Tammy flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! CHEEKY! Good length ball on off, Beaumont bends on her knees and scoops it over the keeper's head for a maximum.
Full down the leg side, Beaumont looks to sweep but misses. Wide not signaled as it might have brushed her pad.
Slower ball on off, Winfield flicks it uppishly towards long on where the fielder collects it on a bounce. A single taken.
Lauren Winfield is the new batter in.

OUT! Knocks her over! Brilliant bowling from Khaka. This is a massive wicket as well. Khaka bowls a slower one around off, Sciver is way early in her slog. She misses and the ball goes behind to knock the off pole out of the ground. Excellent bowling from Khaka. But an excellent inning from Sciver.

FIFTY! 6th one in Women's T20I internationals for Natalie Sciver! She is taking England to a respectable total here. Short ball outside off, Sciver punches it to the deep cover region for a single. 11 runs from the over along with a wicket.
FOUR! Sciver is playing a wonderful knock here! Fullish on middle, Sciver moves to the off side and plays it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Tammy Beaumont is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A promising partnership ends and South Africa pick up their 5th wicket. Ismail looks to cut but it takes the top edge and goes towards the third man region. Khaka settles herself and takes a simple catch.
FOUR! Top shot! England need more of these! Full on middle, Brunt flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball around the pads, Brunt looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it.

Run out chance missed! Short ball outside off, Brunt punches it to the deep cover region and comes back for the second. The fielder throws it to the keeper but Chetty fails to collect. Had she collected and whipped the bails off, Brunt was well out even with her dive.
Shabnim Ismail returns. 3-0-15-0 so far from her. Can she finish her spell with a wicket?
Slower ball outside off, Brunt dances down the track and then punches it to cover for a single. 10 from the over.
Short of a length on off, Sciver pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish outside off, Sciver sweeps it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder throws it back to the bowler but the batters were well in.
Full on middle, Sciver flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.

FOUR! Innovation at its best. Sciver is playing an excellent hand here. A length ball outside off, she moves towards the off side and scoops it over the keeper and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Full and around off, Sciver pushes it to mid off.
Ayabonga Khaka is back on. 2-0-9-1 are her figures so far.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Brunt goes to play the sweep but fails to get any bat on it. Mlaba finishes with 4-0-31-0.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Loopy one on off, Sciver dances down and flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. The two fielders in the deep have no chance.

Tossed up ball on middle, Brunt comes down the track and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. The ball rolls to the off side for a leg bye.
Flatter one outside off, Sciver punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
SIX! Whacked! Looped up ball on off, Sciver bends on her knees and sweeps it over the wide long on region for a maximum. Good start to the over.
Nonkululeko Mlaba is back to deliver for her last over. 3-0-19-0 from her so far.
Flighted ball on middle, Brunt paddles it over the keeper and collects a couple before the fielder cleans it up. Van Niekerk finishes with 4-0-20-2. Excellent outing for her.
Short ball on off, Sciver pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Katherine Brunt is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This was coming as Wilson was looking itchy and was struggling big time. South Africa remain on top at the moment. Floated ball on off, Wilson looks to go over long on but does not get the required elevation and distance on it. Shabnim Ismail settles herself under it and pouches it safely.
Tossed up ball on middle, Sciver sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Wilson drives it to long on for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Sciver punches it to deep cover for a single.
Full on middle, Sciver pushes it to mid on for a single.
Another short one on middle, Sciver pulls it to the mid-wicket region. Another dot ball.
Fullish on off, Sciver pushes it down to mid off for another dot.
Short on off, Sciver pulls but straight to the mid on fielder.
Short ball on middle and leg, Wilson pulls it to deep square leg and crosses over for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Sciver pushes it to deep point for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Fran brings out her reverse sweep and plays it straight to point.
Full on middle, Wilson sweeps it towards the deep square leg region and picks up a couple.
Shortish in length on middle, Sciver pulls it through mid-wicket for another run.
Short ball on the pads, Wilson pulls it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Floated on middle, Sciver drives it to long on for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Wilson digs it out to the off side and the batters take a single.
Length and on off, it is defended.
Shortish and around off, Wilson fends it towards mid off for a quick run.
Shortish and around off, Sciver forces it to deep cover for a run.
Short and on middle, Wilson pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
This time bowls this length ball just outside off, Wilson tries to cut but there is no room on offer. She misses.
Ismail starts her new spell with a short ball outside off, Sciver cuts it to deep point for a run.
Shabnim Ismail is back on. 1-0-8-0 are her figures so far.

NOT OUT! Wilson's dive has saved her. Floated on middle, Wilson bends on her knees and then sweeps it to fine leg. She wants the second and calls her partner for the couple. The fielder throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off. The third umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show that Wilson had made it inside her crease.
An appeal for run out! It is referred upstairs. Wilson looks in and the replays confirm that.
Floated on middle, Wilson drives it back to the bowler.
Could have been close! Full on middle, Sciver pushes it down to mid on and takes off for a single. The fielder fails to collect it and the batters make it easily.
Tossed up ball on middle, Wilson heaves it to deep mid-wicket and picks up only a single.
Loopy delivery down the leg side, Sciver sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a run.
Low full toss on middle, Wilson sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off. 50/3 at the halfway mark.
FOUR! Smashed! A gift from Mlaba, a high full toss on middle, Sciver slams it wide of the long on fielder for a boundary.
Full and outside off, this time Wilson connects her reverse sweep and gets a run as the ball goes towards point.

STUMPING MISSED! That was an easy chance. Flighted ball around off, Wilson comes charging down the track and looks to smack the ball over ropes. But the ball turns away and bounces extra. It goes behind but Chetty fails to collect it cleanly. The ball hits her fingers and lobs. She collects the ball and whips the bails off now. The third umpire has been called and the replays show that Wilson managed to get her bat down in time.
Full and on the pads, Wilson looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Another reverse sweep attempt and Mlaba bowls it full and outside off, she though fails to connect this time.
Brings the reverse sweep out and gets off the mark. 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
Full and outside off, Wilson sweeps it but this time she finds square leg.
Loopy ball on off, Wilson drives it well but finds the cover fielder.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Fran Wilson is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant running catch from Ismail and she sends the English skipper packing with a stunner! Full ball around off, Knight looks to go downtown but it is not timed too well. It goes well wide of the long on fielder. Ismail from that position runs to her left and covers a lot of ground and then holds onto the catch. Van Niekerk removes her opposite number.
Full and outside off, Knight pushes it towards mid off.
Dane Van Niekerk is on.
Full and around off, swept for a single towards deep square leg.
Short and outside off, Sciver cuts it through point for a single. Wanted the second but the fielder in the deep was quick to the ball.
Full and around off, Knight comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a single.
Quick single! Floated full and just around off, Sciver looks to drive but the ball takes an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls towards the off side and take a run.
On middle, it is defended.
Full and around off, paddled to fine leg for a run.
Nonkululeko Mlaba is back on! 1-0-9-0 are her figures so far.
Length ball around off, Knight works it towards square leg and takes a run.
On the pads, worked towards deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! A boundary after 25 balls. This should break the shackles. A low full toss on middle, Sciver drills it down the ground and the ball races away to the long on fence.
Shortish and around off, Sciver punches it to mid on.
Full and on middle, Knight looks to flick but the ball takes the inner part of her willow and goes to deep square leg for a run.
Full and around off from Khaka to start her second over, Knight drives it well but finds mid off.
Shortish and around off, Sciver goes on the back foot and forces it towards covers. Just 3 from the over and 31/2 at the end of the Powerplay. Excellent one for South Africa.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid off.
WIDE! Tries something different but ends up bowling it down the leg side. Sciver tries flicking but misses.
Tight bowling from Kapp. She is keeping it straight and simple. Once again Sciver pushes it to mid on.
Full and on off, pushed to mid on.
Short and outside off, Knight cuts it over backward point but there is  protection in the deep so just a run. Knight is off the mark on the 6th ball.
Length ball on middle, Sciver works it behind square for a run.
Length ball around off, Knight defends it out. Just 2 extras and a wicket from the over.
Length ball on middle, this time Knight pushes it towards mid on.
Another full ball around off, it is pushed to mid off.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off.
She finally gets it right and bowls a good length ball around off, Knight keeps it out.
WIDE! Another wide! Khaka still trying to find her line right as she dishes another ball down the leg side. Knight once again tries flicking but misses.
WIDE! Khaka bowls this down the leg side. Knight looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Heather Knight, the skipper is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the openers dismissed now and it is all smiles in the Protea camp. Not a wicket-taking ball but Khaka won't care. A low full toss outside off, Wyatt drives it uppishly and it goes straight to point where Lee takes the easiest of chances. Top, top start for the Proteas after a very promising start from England. Two new batters at the crease now.
Ayabonga Khaka is into the attack.
Length ball on the pads, Wyatt looks to flick but is hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they take a quick run. Leg bye signaled.
Play and a miss! Wyatt looks to defend but is beaten.
Natalie Sciver is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kapp gets the first breakthrough. Jones mistimes this fuller length ball towards mid off as she tries to clear the infield but it takes the upper part of her bat and lobs towards extra cover where Tryon pouches it with ease. She was looking really good and would be disappointed.
Shortish and around off, Jones moves towards the off side and turns it towards deep square leg. A couple taken as the fielder from fine leg makes a diving stop.
Quick run! Brilliant running! Wyatt is doing well to give the strike back to Jones who is being the aggressor in this stand. A short ball around off, she taps it towards point and takes a run.
Angled into the batter on a good length,  Jones works it towards fine leg for a run.

Short this time, Jones quickly goes on the back foot and pulls it towards mid-wicket. Again fails to time it well and the ball bounces just in front of the fielder there. She misfields and a run is taken.
Full and just outside off, Jones finds mid off with her mistimed drive. Shakes her head as she feels she should've drilled it down the ground.
A couple now! Short one on middle, Jones pulls it between mid-wicket and mid on. She does not time it well but good enough for a couple.
Length ball around off, this time Jones pushes it towards point.

FOUR! Poor bowling and Jones is pouncing on the opportunities offered. Her 4th boundary of the innings. Ismail bowls it short and outside off, Jones goes on the back foot and punches it through point for a boundary.
She starts with an overpitched ball outside off, Wyatt lunges forward and drives it to deep point for a run to get off the mark.
Just one over of spin as Shabnim Ismail comes to bowl now.
Top finish to the over. Just 4 runs off it, that too with a boundary. Landed on a length around off and middle, Jones pushes it towards mid on.
Around off, Jones comes forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Flicked in the gap! Goes full this time, Jones charges down the track and whips it between mid-wicket and mid on. The mid-wicket fielder gives it a chase but comes second.
Another good length ball angled into the batter, this time Jones flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball angled into the pads, Jones looks to flick but misses.
Beaten! Good first ball from Kapp. Length ball outside off, Jones looks to force it on the off side but gets beaten.
Marizanne Kapp to bowl from the other end.
Single to end the over! 9 from the first one. A full toss on middle, Jones comes down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Full and around off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Another boundary! Mlaba flights this one and bowls it slightly fuller on off, Jones skips down the track and lofts it over mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! A gift from Mlaba and Jones accepts it gleefully. High full toss outside off, Jones drives it past the mid off fielder for a boundary.
On middle, this time Jones pushes it towards mid on.
Mlaba starts with a full ball just around off, Jones comes forward and pushes it towards mid off.

We are all set to begin! The South African players are in a huddle and are getting final advice from their skipper before they make their way out to the field. Amy Jones and Danielle Wyatt, the England openers follow them out. Nonkululeko Mlaba will start with the ball.
Both sides make their way out for their respective National Anthems.
Pitch report - Charlotte Edwards says that it looks like a good pitch with no demons on it. Adds that the pitch will offer some spin in the later half of the game.
England Playing XI - Amy Jones (wk), Danielle Wyatt, Heather Knight (c), Natalie Sciver, Fran Wilson, Tammy Beaumont, Lauren Winfield, Katherine Brunt, Anya Shrubsole, Sophie Ecclestone, Sarah Glenn.

South Africa Playing XI - Dane Van Niekerk (c), Lizelle Lee, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Mignon du Preez, Sune Luus, Laura Wolvaardt, Trisha Chetty (wk), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.

Heather Knight, England captain, says that she would've bowled as well. On the recent tri-series, Knight feels that series like these helps the team know their strengths and weaknesses. Says that it is a really big World Cup for them. On their positive record against South Africa, Knight says that it does not really matter and the players need to turn up on the given day.

Dane Van Niekerk, South Africa captain, says that she wants to chase first by restricting the strong England batting line-up. Adds that during the Big Bash, defending was difficult on this track. Tells that they lost the series against New Zealand but it was touch and go there.
Toss - South Africa have won the toss and THEY WILL BOWL FIRST.

Match no. 4 sees England facing South Africa in both the sides' first appearance in this year's T20 Women's World Cup. England, the last time finalists, have one of the strongest sides in the tournament and are favourites going into this game. Heather Knight and Danielle Wyatt will be leading the batting attack and would hope that they put in a terrific performance. South Africa, on the other hand, come into this tournament on the back of a series loss against New Zealand. Lizelle Lee and Mignon du Preez have been in good form. Their captain has recovered from an injury and would hope that she comes good and help in starting the tournament with a win. Who will be able to open their account in the points table? England or South Africa? Toss and team updates in a while.
